newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 20.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Food group said its half year net profit rose to A$48.2 million from A$41.0 million in the previous corresponding half and the company said its full year result was likely to similar to the previous year.

A decision by Britain's Department of Trade and Industry to release the pub estate, Inntrepreneur Pub Company Ltd, which is jointly owned by Grand Metropolitan Plc and Foster's, means those companies are now free to seek a stock market flotation, valuing the company at some 800 million pounds, analysts said.
Cinema group said on Wednesday it was accelerating its A$500 million expansion program by entering the Chilean cinema industry with a A$12 million investment.

Analysts forecast the construction will announce a half year net pre-abnormal profit between A$33 to A$35 million compared to a net profit of A$27.1 million in the previous corresponding half and lift its interim dividend to between 7.5 to 8.5 cents a share from 6.5 cents a year earlier.

Australia's flag carrier is seen posting a flat pre-abnormal result for the six months to Decmber 31 with the median forecast of analysts contacted by Reuters being A$148 million, compared to A$148.1 million in the first half of 1995/96.

Retailer David Jones Ltd plans to wind down the operations of its troubled South Australian John Martin's operations with a A$100 million redevelopment planned for its Adelaide city site, the Adelaide Advertiser reported on Thursday.
